Current offer (base): $175,000
Proposed exception: sign-on $30,000 (one-time), equity: increase from 0.18% -> 0.28% (4-year cliff+annual vest)
Rationale: seniority mismatch and risk of losing to counteroffer; immediate impact on product launch and PM ownership.

I've attached the candidate offer packet and a draft comp approval form for review. Can you confirm whether you can approve the sign-on and if we should route the equity refresh to Total Rewards?

Candidate contact: Elliot Summers (elliot.summers@gmail.com)
Recruiter: Hannah @ TalentMatch (external)
